chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: Basie's piano restraint and too many riffs behind a soloist
summary: Basie and Duke left space for soloists; Dickenson dislikes heavy background rhythm and riffs that crowd the soloist.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

the sound you know. Sometimes a guy can play too much piano and drown out everything you know. He'd play the solo while you were playing the solo. That's no good. And Basie just (unintelligible).
